annotation.method: Codex read all 25 physical pages in order from local page renderings because the PDF's embedded Type 3 font has no usable Unicode map. The audit covered the abstract, Sections 1-4, Lemma 1, Theorem 1, every displayed estimate and algorithm, all three numerical figures, and all 23 references; it then checked Mathlib and the exact frozen 44-object NumStability surface and compiled exact N/L feasibility proofs.
annotation.reason: The project owner assigned the P46 source selection and benchmark annotation to Codex.

corpus_membership: This paper is part of the current corpus listed in metadata/manifest.json.

rejected_candidates.reason: The lemma uses unquantified O(epsilon^2) terms. Replacing them by newly chosen exact constants would add mathematical content not stated in the source. Once local-error bounds are assumed, its accumulation argument is elementary and receives no substantial frozen-library shortcut.

The theorem combines the elementary telescoping residual-gap identity with Lemma 1's first-order estimates. The exact residual-gap core compiles in 36 lines in N and 35 in L; the L proof uses only generic matrix-vector add/scale lemmas. The theorem is therefore neither a T1/T2 library-advantage task nor difficult enough for T3, and its printed big-O remainder cannot be sharpened without inventing a statement.

These are short deductions from Theorem 1 plus convergence or monotonicity facts that the paper explicitly attributes to earlier references. They are not independent substantial internally proved tasks.

rejected_candidates.candidate: CG, BCG, CGS, CGNE, and CGNR experiments
rejected_candidates.reason: The plots and observed attainable accuracies are numerical examples, not universal proof tasks.

T1.decision: Skipped. The frozen substantial matrix-vector error theorem corresponds to equation (12), which P46 explicitly assumes rather than proves. For the paper's own residual-gap algebra, L has only elementary add/scale helpers and no substantial advantage.

T2.decision: Skipped. No internally proved P46 result receives two distinct substantial non-Mathlib shortcuts from the exact compiled NumStability surface.

T3.decision: Skipped. The source-faithful exact residual-gap recurrence and norm summation are well below the T2 difficulty floor, while formalizing the printed big-O bounds as a harder exact theorem would require adding constants and hypotheses not supplied by the paper. The later convergence facts are cited background or experimental observations.

selection_policy: Use only claims and proof content stated in this paper.
Do not turn the assumed matrix-vector error estimate (12) into a result proved by P46.
Do not replace unquantified big-O remainders by invented exact constants.
Treat the exact telescoping residual-gap recurrence as a feasibility probe, not as a tier task, because private N/L proofs show it is short and has no substantial library advantage.
Assign a tier only after exact private N and L proofs compile.
